column1: # Shape values this repository is allowed to carry. Shape rows only; the gate refuses a name row.
# Benchmark history lives here, so its path appears in the tree. The baseline block below
# Cargo's lock file pins every dependency at an exact version; these are the library
# versions the build uses, not a version of a deployed system. Cargo.toml carries the
# package's own release number; dependencies there are written as major.minor.
# The site (site/, scripts/site.sh, the site workflow). Tool pins are build inputs, like
# Cargo.lock, not versions of a deployed system: the zola and wrangler versions, and the
# release tags beside the SHA-pinned actions.
# CI (T17). Release tags beside the SHA-pinned actions, and the cargo-deny pin, are build
# inputs, like the site workflow's tool pins.
# The release workflow (phase 2 T11) pins the same actions as ci; CHANGELOG.md carries the
# product's own release numbers, like Cargo.toml.
# deny.toml allows the SPDX bzip2 licence (phase 3 D-2), whose identifier carries the
# upstream release number of bzip2; it is a licence name, not a version in use.
# scripts/site.sh serves and tests on the loopback address; a dotted quad also matches the
# Bytes of the self-hosted font that happen to read as an IPv6 address.
# the three values above, as these rows carry them
# BEGIN baseline-agent allow (vendored; do not edit)
# The shape values the vendored files carry, for a consumer's .publish-allow.tsv. vendor.sh
# writes these rows between the consumer's baseline-agent allow markers, 2.3.0 filled in
# with the release number of the marker blocks; check.sh compares them. Shape rows only.
# the stamp records the release it was vendored from
# the marker lines of the two vendored blocks, and these rows themselves
# the directories the vendored rules and skills cite; generic names, allowed anywhere
